metadata.description: Nome do workspace de Log Analytics do laboratório.

properties.description:
Esta consulta identifica inclusão bem-sucedida de um usuário em uma
função privilegiada do Entra ID. O recorte cobre funções de diretório
com capacidade de alterar identidade, segurança ou dados da organização.
properties.query:
let privilegedRoles = dynamic([
    "Global Administrator",
    "Privileged Role Administrator",
    "Security Administrator",
    "Exchange Administrator",
    "SharePoint Administrator",
    "User Administrator",
    "Application Administrator",
    "Cloud Application Administrator"
]);
AuditLogs
| where Category =~ "RoleManagement"
| where OperationName has "Add member to role"
| where Result =~ "success"
| mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResources
| extend ResourceType = tostring(TargetResource.type)
| extend ResourceName = tostring(TargetResource.displayName)
| extend ResourceUpn = tostring(TargetResource.userPrincipalName)
| extend ActorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend UserUpn = iff(ResourceType =~ "User", ResourceUpn, "")
| extend RoleName = iff(ResourceType =~ "Role", ResourceName, "")
| summarize
    TargetUpn = max(UserUpn),
    RoleName = max(RoleName),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by CorrelationId, OperationName, ActorUpn
| where RoleName in (privilegedRoles) and isnotempty(TargetUpn) and isnotempty(ActorUpn)
| extend
    TargetName = tostring(split(TargetUpn, "@")[0]),
    UPNSuffix = tostring(split(TargetUpn, "@")[1])
